constraints: Use Leapp or the supported in-place upgrade path, or rebuild the host on the target major release.
Extended Life Cycle Support is a separate paid subscription; do not count it as standard maintenance.

steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported RHEL major release, confirm subscriptions and third-party packages, then drain and return it to service.
steps.title: Upgrade the RHEL host

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target RHEL release.
Check that package updates resolve on the target release.

sources.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 end of maintenance

rule.summary: RHEL 7 reached the end of its maintenance support phase on 2024-06-30, and older releases ended earlier. The Extended Life Cycle Support add-on is a separate paid subscription.
rule.title: Red Hat Enterprise Linux 7 and older are past maintenance support
